performance.verdict: Campaigns hard-stopped Aug 6; restart decision is the only question.

findings.text: Meta spend dropped to $0 from Aug 6 onward (12 consecutive zero-spend days); all 45 leads and $1,171.64 spend are pre-pause. No current efficiency to measure.
Pre-pause CPL was $26.04 across 45 leads. 3-day signal (Aug 3–5): 9 leads at avg ~$71/day spend vs prior 3 days (Jul 31–Aug 2): 5 leads — efficiency was improving into the pause.
GHL pipeline shows 33 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — 45 paid leads produced zero pipeline entries, indicating a likely intake or CRM mapping failure.
GBP actions fell 23.4% in the last 7 days; IG reach collapsed 98.76% to near zero (1–2/day), removing the organic buffer that typically supports brand search during paid pauses.
GA4 sessions spiked to 206 on Aug 13 despite zero paid spend — directional only per JCL double-count caveat, but sc_clicks held at 21–25 that week, suggesting residual organic intent.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL contact-to-opportunity mapping; 33 contacts and 0 opps confirms an intake leak, not an ads problem.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 33 contacts from the 28-day window but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments booked, meaning leads are arriving but not entering the pipeline. Audit the GHL workflow: check stage triggers, form-to-contact routing, and whether contacts require manual opp creation. Success is confirmed when the next 10 new contacts produce at least 1 opportunity entry automatically. Resolve before campaigns restart — ideally by 2026-08-21.

suggestions.text: Watch for campaign restart authorization; pre-pause CPL of $26.04 and improving 3-day trend justify resuming at prior daily budget (~$69–$75/day).
suggestions.monday_update: Meta campaigns have been fully paused since Aug 6 with $0 spend across 12 days. The pre-pause CPL was $26.04 across 45 leads, and the final 3-day window before pause (Aug 3–5) showed 9 leads — the strongest short run in the series. Once restart is approved, reactivate 'CROA || CBO - 3/17/26' at the prior ~$69–$75/day level, not higher. Confirm CPL holds at or below $30 after 5 days of live data; re-check 2026-08-26.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP and IG organic; both declining sharply during the paid pause risks suppressing branded search intent needed for relaunch.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped 23.4% and IG reach collapsed 98.76% week-over-week during the paid pause. With no paid impressions running, organic is the only brand signal in market and it is shrinking. Flag to the content team that at least baseline IG posting should resume. Re-check GBP action volume on 2026-08-21 to confirm it stabilizes above 5 actions/day before campaigns go live.
